name: Tm Visualization Suite: Composition
pitch: Show how a total splits into parts, and how the mix differs from group to group.
question: What is the whole made of, and how do the parts compare?
useWhen: Show the parts of a whole and compare the mix.
features: Compare groups with one mark per unit
Follow parts from one list to another
Pick a channel and see its mix

hero.alt: Mosaic of store formats by region: column width shows the region's size and block height shows each format's share.
hero.caption: How the mix of store formats differs from region to region

screenshots.alt: Unit chart of orders placed through the web shop, one symbol per order, grouped by delivery method.
screenshots.caption: Select a channel and the unit marks show only its orders

screenshots.alt: Parallel sets for the top-up segment only, with bands to click and collect, express, home delivery and parcel locker.
screenshots.caption: Select a segment and the bands show only where it goes

questions: Which delivery methods does each order channel use?
How does the mix of customer segments differ by store?
Which parts make up most of the total?
audience: Analysts and BI leads who explain a total through its parts and compare the mix between groups.

featureStrips.heading: Read one whole as 100 percent
featureStrips.text: A stacked bar splits the whole into its parts, so the biggest parts are easy to compare.
featureStrips.alt: Single stacked bar to 100 percent, with segments for each order channel and delivery method.

featureStrips.heading: Count the parts as squares
featureStrips.text: A waffle gives each order a small square, so the share of each segment reads as a count you can see.
featureStrips.alt: Waffle chart of orders, one square for each order, coloured by customer segment.

featureStrips.heading: Compare groups with one mark per unit
featureStrips.text: Unit marks stack a symbol for every order under each delivery method, so group size and mix show together.
featureStrips.alt: Unit chart with one symbol per order for four delivery methods, coloured by order channel.

featureStrips.heading: Follow parts from one list to another
featureStrips.text: Parallel sets draw bands between two lists, so you see how one grouping splits into the other.
featureStrips.alt: Parallel sets with customer segments on the left joined to delivery methods on the right.

featureStrips.heading: Pick a channel and see its mix
featureStrips.text: Select an order channel and the mosaic shows only its orders, so you compare its mix with the rest.
featureStrips.alt: Mosaic of store formats by region for web shop orders, with column width for region size.
